The average critical displacement, max load of the 4 alloys and the average DIC strain averaged over a 0.5mm box at fracture initiation. Since no fracture criteria are applied in the macro-models, the load drop, as seen in Fig. 39, in the simulated curves are completely due to geometry effect of VDA bending. The simulated load- displacement curve in the H2-T4 alloy completely follows that of the experimental ones, it may indicate that the H2-T4 alloy is very ductile and there is no actual damage (crack initiation and propagation) in the material during the process of VDA bending. The crack initiation strain (0.515) measured in Fig. 40 may be only applied to the material surface. The material in the bulk should be much more ductile. The FE calculated load-displacement curve of experiments for H2-T6 and H4-T4 and the peak load displacement and peak load values are also similar, except sample 1 and 3 of H4-T4. The load drop slope, however, of the experiments are faster than those of simulation, indicating there are slightly some surface cracking and the cracks propagate slightly into the thickness. 5.2.3.
